recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the applied FHIR-28283 guidance and removes a misleading canonical URI that could otherwise cause implementers to use a non-existent UCUM system URL.
issue_request: FHIR-28283 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CDS change request for R5 asking to add text, similar to the FHIRPath Quantity appendix, describing implicit conversion of UCUM definite-duration time-valued units to CQL calendar duration units in the Clinical Reasoning Using CQL/Using Expressions discussion.
initial_application: Jira comments cite commit c7660fc81c9a286d9f1db2210560f4d16a29a00f and HL7/fhir#2834. That commit added the requested Use of FHIR Quantity subsection, conversion table, and example to source/clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html, but introduced a typo in the UCUM canonical system URI as http://unitsofmeausure.org.
additional_context: source/clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html is in current build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and source/clinicalreasoning-module.html. The FHIRPath appendix named by the Jira resolution uses the correct http://unitsofmeasure.org URI and the same conversion concept. Community and Confluence checks found no final FHIR-core decision that supersedes the requested FHIR-specific Quantity-to-calendar-duration mapping.
reconciliation: Changed only the misspelled UCUM canonical system URI in the issue-added Clinical Reasoning/CQL text to http://unitsofmeasure.org, leaving the already-applied conversion guidance intact.
source_changes: source/clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html: corrected http://unitsofmeausure.org to http://unitsofmeasure.org in the Use of FHIR Quantity subsection.

related_jiras.note: A later Submitted CQL IG question about FHIR Quantity behavior was found in concept search, but it is not a final FHIR-core decision and does not change this URI fix.
A later CQL-spec resolved issue about calendar and definite duration comparisons is outside the FHIR-core source scope reconciled here.
